papers.title: Rollout models of human planning with exact action probabilities.
papers.reason: The paper directly proposes and fits a tractable rollout-based computational model of human multi-step planning behavior.

papers.title: Nonverbal reasoning in children and adolescents with cerebral palsy: associations with gross motor function, MRI, and EEG findings.
papers.reason: It concerns clinical cognitive assessment with MRI and EEG in a human pediatric population, but the target construct is nonverbal reasoning rather than executive-function modelling or biomarker classification.

papers.title: Hidden Drowsiness in Wakefulness: Differences in Resting-State EEG Profiles in Natural Short Sleepers Versus Recommended Length Sleepers.
papers.reason: Resting-state EEG differences related to drowsiness and sleep duration may inform models of arousal and attention, but it is not centered on executive-function tasks or cognitive impairment assessment.

papers.title: NONPHARMACOLOGICAL REHABILITATION FOR POST-STROKE COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT: FUNCTIONAL TRANSFER AND MAINTENANCE
papers.reason: The review addresses clinical cognitive rehabilitation and functional outcomes after stroke, but it does not specifically model or measure executive function, attention, or working memory mechanisms.
